_comment: Demo data for a lived-in dashboard, written by `make local-demo` / `local-seed demo` on top of synthetic.json. Generated by generate-demo.mjs: edit that, not this. Test C Unit: 30 invented members, 3 users, 3 kiosks and about 12 weeks of activity covering training nights, musters, storm callouts, a flood operation, searches, community events, maintenance, duty officers, guests, a visiting member, members signed in now, a forgotten sign-out, an edited and a deleted period, a departing, a deleted, a new and a never-seen member. Times are relative to when seeding runs (`now-2h`, `monday-3w+1d+19h`: Sydney local time), so re-running it brings the data up to date; periods that would land in the future are skipped.

location._comment: Member sync last succeeded 5 hours ago, as the hourly dispatcher would leave it.

person._comment: Absent from SES since 4 days ago: pending deletion by member sync's absence pass.
Soft-deleted a month ago; their older periods remain.
A recruit added this week with no activity yet.
Never signed in: shows as never seen.

user._comment: Admin at Test C Unit only, subscribed to its daily summary.
Read only at Test C Unit.
A disabled former admin: no `enabled`, as the app writes it.

session._comment: Front door kiosk: key-enrolled, last seen a minute ago, Who's here always on.
Training room kiosk: key-enrolled, pinned light, last seen two days ago.
Retired after weeks offline: no `active`, stamped `retired_at`.

comment.S: Signed in late, was at the station first

period._comment: Edited after sign-out: version 2, updated after it ended.
Deleted by an admin: has `deleted` and no `location_live`, like a real delete.
Signed in 15 hours ago: their next scan hits the forgot-to-sign-out screen.
